result: Implemented the one-pass sAlex production engine and captured the authorized 10,000-record official-source pilot at 16.870766 s / 592.741 records/s, implying a 4.896 h naive lower-bound for 10,447,765 records. Because that estimate excludes production SQLite writes, WBM target-index construction, StructureMatcher comparisons, compression, and artifact handling, GitHub Actions is not selected for the full run. Kaggle CPU is selected as the full-run backend; the pilot request is disabled and the production run remains fail-closed until checkpoint 0036 implements submission and evidence retrieval.
